sourceTitle: Pawtucket: 6. CONSTRUCTION AND RECONSTRUCTION OF STREETS AND SIDEWALKS
exactQuestion: Shall an act passed at the January 2026 session of the General Assembly entitled “An Act authorizing the City of Pawtucket to provide for the design, construction, reconstruction, repair, and equipping of streets, sidewalks, and other transportation infrastructure improvements including, but not limited to, drainage and landscaping and authorizing the financing thereof, including the issuance of not more than $2,000,000 bonds and notes therefor, to fund the capital improvement program for the two fiscal years 2028 and 2029” be approved?
